name: Baphomet closed eyes and enlarged central eye
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this fixed game UV texture atlas, not a character portrait. Preserve the exact existing UV island positions, sizes, borders, silhouettes, anatomy and background, with no repacking, rotation or resizing of islands. Make ALL horns/keratin much darker: deep charcoal and aged dark umber, very restrained muted brown highlights, no cream ivory stripes. Skin becomes darker charcoal gray, keeping enough local detail to read. In the face island at lower right ONLY: completely CLOSE the normal left and right eyes with natural dark eyelids and crease lines; absolutely no visible eyeballs, yellow irises, glow, or eyelashes in these two sockets. The third central forehead eye stays in its exact center position but enlarge the opening and iris to about 1.6 times its current size, intense molten gold pupil, bright ivory-gold inner glow framed by thick dark lids. This single central eye is the ONLY open eye and only strong bright accent. Preserve nose/mouth/face shape and the overall island extent. Keep the irregular keratin growth over body muscle; no blood or red spatters anywhere. The central coiled-horn island must become dark brown-black with subtle longitudinal ridges. No captions, borders, new islands or character rendering. This will be wrapped onto an existing low-poly model so layout fidelity is essential.

name: Twilight shattered moon weapons
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW revised fantasy MMORPG weapon set concept board, three full weapons side by side: two-handed greatsword, longbow, staff. Image 1 is the PREVIOUS DESIGN reference: keep the moonlit silver/deep midnight palette and weapon categories but substantially redesign the shapes; it was too smooth, regular, symmetrical, and reliant on round glowing balls. Image 2 is a NATIVE GAME REFERENCE for silhouette rhythm: study the Black Knight greatsword's crooked cutting edge, asymmetrical guard, engraved metal, and the bow's sinuous irregular limbs and curling ornament. Do not copy their colors or literal shapes. User direction: MUCH stronger MOON identity, irregular and lavishly ornate forms that feel like an ultimate weapon set. Build silhouettes from overlapping unequal crescent blades, broken lunar crescents, waxing/waning moon-phase inlays, and swept silver branches that twist organically with unequal tips. Greatsword: broad asymmetrical flamberge-like moonsteel blade, a long curved cutting edge, off-center lunar aperture, elaborate unequal crescent guard, inset broken half-moon and subtle dark star-map engravings. No identical forked parallel blades. Bow: dramatically curved asymmetric upper and lower limbs, layered crescent fins of different lengths, flowing carved silver scrollwork, one clear functional bowstring, half-moon core nestled off-center near grip. Staff: monumental tilted incomplete crescent crown with smaller uneven crescent arcs intertwined inside, crescent-shaped illuminated moonstone rather than a round planet, long substantial shaft with varied swept silver ornaments. Dense and luxurious but readable at small game scale. Silver and weathered near-black metal dominate; pale ice-blue moonlight is restricted to sharp edges, engraved moon phases, and small cracks. Distinct silhouette for each weapon, coherent family, physically thick metal, not jewelry made of thin wire. Very dark charcoal backdrop, high quality 3D fantasy game concept render, full silhouettes entirely in frame with generous gaps. No hands, characters, blood, fire, skulls, duplicate weapons, excessive particle fog or mirror symmetry. Minimal text: TWILIGHT — SHATTERED MOON; labels GREATSWORD / BOW / STAFF. Proposed design concepts, not existing game screenshots.

name: Seamless dark keratin material
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: tileable material texture for a 3D antler cleaver, not concept art. The reference image is ONLY a material/color guide for its horn and antler surfaces. Generate one edge-to-edge flat orthographic rectangular material texture filling the ENTIRE image: aged natural antler keratin with dense fine longitudinal ridges, shallow organic fissures and subtle layers. Ridges run vertically from bottom to top. Color gradient: lower 35 percent dark charred walnut brown, middle muted warm gray-brown, upper 20 percent worn gray ivory, with just the very top slightly lighter. Keep details natural and restrained, smooth color transitions, no horizontal seams or sharp bands. No actual horns, weapon, objects, lighting setup, shadows, highlights from an external source, background, border, text, labels, metal, red, blood or transparency. This is a uniform flat PBR-style albedo texture sheet, softly lit, usable directly on curved tapering 3D horns. Horizontal edges should tile seamlessly. Match the bone/horn material of the provided weapon design.
